exceptions.rationale: No released npm package in the current TypeSpec line contains the upstream path-sanitization fix yet. This exception is temporary while tracking microsoft/typespec#11777 and must be removed when the patched release is available.
exceptions.reachabilityEvidence: TJSV invokes only the @typespec/json-schema emitter with a fixed plain bundleId. src/emitter.mjs now calls assertTypeSpecEmitterInputSafe before output-directory creation or compiler execution; test/unit/typespec-emitter-path-boundary.test.mjs rejects slash/backslash-bearing escaped identifiers and proves the compiler cannot run for that input.
